title: Prison: The Solution or the Problem?
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.prompt: “A decrease in crime in the Netherlands and parts of the US is attributable more to 1_________________ than to incarceration.”
questions.translation: Netherlands 和美國部分地區犯罪率下降，更多可歸因於 ______，而非監禁。

blocks.text: 這是 Sentence Completion。空格前有 “attributable more to”，後面有 “than to incarceration”，所以答案需要是一個原因或政策方向。題目已經指出地點是 Netherlands and parts of the US，因此應先看文章開頭。
“In the Netherlands and parts of the USA such as Johnson County, a move towards rehabilitating offenders has helped to reduce both crime and incarceration rates.”
在 Netherlands 和 USA 部分地區，例如 Johnson County，轉向 rehabilitating offenders 已經有助於同時降低犯罪率和監禁率。
“Without a shadow of a doubt, out of all European countries, the UK has adopted the most hardline approach to offenders.”
毫無疑問，在所有歐洲國家之中，UK 對 offenders 採取了最強硬的做法。
只看首尾句，可以先估 Paragraph 1 的功能是比較兩種路線：Netherlands / parts of the USA 採取 rehabilitation，UK 則採取 hardline incarceration approach。這正好對應題目問 “crime decrease” 應歸因於甚麼。
題目中最有定位力的字是：
原文第一句同時出現 Netherlands、parts of the USA 和 reduce crime，所以要停下細讀：
“a move towards rehabilitating offenders has helped to reduce both crime and incarceration rates.”
轉向 rehabilitating offenders 已經有助於同時降低犯罪率和監禁率。
這句的主語是 “a move towards rehabilitating offenders”。核心動詞是 “has helped to reduce”。
結果是 “both crime and incarceration rates”。也就是說，犯罪下降和監禁下降都和 rehabilitating offenders 這個政策方向有關。
題目把原文 “has helped to reduce crime” 改寫成 “A decrease in crime … is attributable more to”。這是原因和結果的改寫：
答案形式檢查： rehabilitating offenders = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
放入題目後是： A decrease in crime … is attributable more to rehabilitating offenders than to incarceration.句子意思完整，文法自然。
學生可能被 “incarceration rates” 吸引，因為原文也說 incarceration rates 下降。但題目已經把incarceration 放在 “than to incarceration” 後面，表示它不是空格答案。空格要填的是造成下降的政策方向，即 rehabilitating offenders。

questions.prompt: “The closure of prisons in the Netherlands 2 _________________ at an unprecedented rate over recent years.”
questions.translation: 近年來，Netherlands 關閉監獄的速度 ______，達到前所未有的程度。

blocks.text: 這題是 Sentence Completion。空格位於主語 “The closure of prisons in the Netherlands” 之後，所以需要動詞短語。題目中的 “at an unprecedented rate” 會對應原文的 “phenomenal pace”。
“The trend towards imposing prison sentences on offenders in the UK seems all the harsher because the Dutch Justice Ministry is actively in the process of systematically closing down prisons.”
UK 對 offenders 判處監禁的趨勢顯得更加嚴厲，因為 Dutch Justice Ministry 正積極、系統性地關閉監獄。
“If anything, the Dutch reform of the prison system has been accelerating at a phenomenal pace, with 19 of the prisons being shut down in 2014 alone.”
如果說有甚麼變化的話，Dutch prison system reform 一直以驚人的速度加快；單在 2014 年，就有 19 所監獄被關閉。
只看首尾句，可以先估這段主題是 Dutch prison closures，而且重點在 closure 的速度和規模。這正好回應題目中的 “at an unprecedented rate”。
原文中對應最清楚的句子是：
“the Dutch reform of the prison system has been accelerating at a phenomenal pace”
Dutch prison system reform 一直以驚人的速度加快。
“has been accelerating at a phenomenal pace”
一直在加速，而且速度驚人。
題目把 “phenomenal pace” 改寫成 “unprecedented rate”。兩者都表示速度非常快、不同尋常。空格放在主語後面，需要完整動詞短語，所以答案要保留 “has been accelerating”。
“The closure of prisons in the Netherlands”
“the Dutch reform of the prison system”
答案形式檢查： has been accelerating = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
放入題目後是： The closure of prisons in the Netherlands has been accelerating at an unprecedented rate over recent years.文法完整。
“28 prisons were closed in total” 和 “19 … in 2014 alone” 都是重要數字，但它們不能直接放入空格。題目需要動詞短語，不是數字或名詞。Completion 題要先看空格文法，再找原文答案。

questions.prompt: “Against 3 _________________, the Netherlands is seeing a drop in crime along with the closure of prisons.”
questions.translation: 與 ______ 相反，Netherlands 在關閉監獄的同時，犯罪率也正在下降。

blocks.text: 空格位於 “Against” 後面，需要名詞短語。題目中的 “drop in crime along with the closure of prisons” 對應 Paragraph 3 末句。這題很可能考 “Defying all expectations” 的改寫。
“As would be expected, closures of prisons in the Netherlands have led to a drop in the numbers of incarcerated offenders.”
正如人們會預期的那樣，Netherlands 關閉監獄導致被監禁 offenders 的數字下降。
“Defying all expectations of the pro-incarceration lobbyists, crime rates in the Netherlands are also decreasing in direct proportion to the closure of prisons.”
出乎支持監禁的遊說者所有預期之外，Netherlands 的犯罪率也正隨著監獄關閉而按比例下降。
只看首尾句，可以看到這段先講 expected result，再講 unexpected result。被監禁人數下降是預期之中；犯罪率也下降則挑戰 pro-incarceration lobbyists 的看法。
原文的 “Defying all expectations” 就是 “Against all expectations” 的改寫基礎：
“Defying all expectations of the pro-incarceration lobbyists…”
出乎支持監禁的遊說者所有預期之外……
“Defying all expectations of the pro-incarceration lobbyists, crime rates in the Netherlands are also decreasing in direct proportion to the closure of prisons.”
出乎支持監禁的遊說者所有預期之外，Netherlands 的犯罪率也正隨著監獄關閉而按比例下降。
題目把 “Defying all expectations” 改成 “Against all expectations”。這是非常直接的同義改寫： Defying all expectations= Against all expectations= 違反所有預期；出乎意料題目把 “crime rates … decreasing” 改成 “a drop in crime”。
題目把 “closure of prisons” 保留為原字。
答案形式檢查： all expectations = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
放入題目後是： Against all expectations, the Netherlands is seeing a drop in crime along with the closure of prisons.文法和意思都自然。

可以填 “pro-incarceration lobbyists” 嗎？不適合。原文是 “expectations of the pro-incarceration lobbyists”，題目是 “Against ______”。最自然、最符合原文短語結構的是 “all expectations”。若填pro-incarceration lobbyists，句子變成 “Against pro-incarceration lobbyists”，文法上仍可能勉強成立，但它沒有保留 “expectations” 這個真正被 defy 的對象。

questions.prompt: “Since statistics do not support the argument for incarceration, this has made many 4_________________ of such a practice.”
questions.translation: 由於統計數字不支持監禁論點，這使許多人開始 ______ 這種做法。

blocks.text: 空格在 “made many” 後面，需要動詞短語。題目中的 “statistics” 和 “argument for incarceration”指向 Paragraph 4 開頭，因為該段用 “such statistics laid bare” 引出人們對 incarceration 的質疑。
“With such statistics laid bare for all to see, many are now beginning to question the validity of incarceration as a method of reforming offenders.”
當這些統計數字清楚擺在所有人面前時，許多人現在開始質疑 incarceration 作為 reforming offenders 方法的有效性。
“Serving a probation or community service order would also be 12 times less costly than the average prison placement for an offender.”
服 probation 或 community service order 的成本，也會比一名 offender 的平均 prison placement低 12 倍。
只看首尾句，可以判斷這段處理「統計數字令監禁有效性受到質疑」以及「替代方案更便宜」。
Question 4 的 wording 幾乎直接來自第一句。
“With such statistics laid bare for all to see, many are now beginning to question the validity of incarceration…”
這句同時包含 statistics、many 和 incarceration，值得細讀。
“many are now beginning to question the validity of incarceration”
許多人現在開始質疑 incarceration 的有效性。
“this has made many ______ of such a practice.”
要讓句子完整，答案要放入 “question the validity”。放入後： this has made many question the validity of such a practice.意思是：這使許多人質疑這種做法的有效性。
“statistics do not support the argument for incarceration”
“With such statistics laid bare for all to see”
“incarceration as a method of reforming offenders”
答案形式檢查： question the validity = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
“as a method of reforming offenders” 很容易吸引學生填太長答案，但空格後已經有 “of such a practice”。真正需要的是動詞短語 “question the validity”，不需要把 incarceration 或 method of reforming offenders 再抄一次。

questions.prompt: “In fact, incarceration may serve to fuel rather 5 _________________ crime, thereby defeating the purpose of such a punishment.”
questions.translation: 事實上，incarceration 可能會加劇犯罪，而非 ______ 犯罪，因此違背這種懲罰的目的。

blocks.text: 空格跟在 “rather” 後面，常見搭配是 “rather than + verb”。題目中的 “fuel crime” 會對應原文
“create the problem of crime”。要找 prison term 對 crime 的效果。
目標段落：Paragraph 5第一句：“More tellingly, reoffending statistics published by the UK Ministry of Justice show a lower rate among offenders who receive a community sentence rather than a custodial one.”
更有說服力的是，UK Ministry of Justice 發布的再犯統計顯示，接受 community sentence 的offenders，比接受 custodial sentence 的 offenders 再犯率更低。
“Interestingly, the report also argued that there should be a range of community-based sentences which would be cheaper and more effective alternatives to prison.”
有趣的是，該報告也主張應設立一系列 community-based sentences，作為比監獄更便宜、更有效的替代方案。
只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph 5 會說 community sentences 效果較好，prison sentence 的效果較差。Question 5 問 incarceration 是否加劇 crime，正好定位到這段。
原文中最接近的句子是：
“This supports the argument that serving a prison term tends to create rather than alleviate the problem of crime.”
這支持一個論點：服 prison term 往往會製造犯罪問題，而非減輕犯罪問題。
“serving a prison term tends to create rather than alleviate the problem of crime.”
服 prison term 往往會製造犯罪問題，而非減輕犯罪問題。
題目把 “create” 改寫成 “fuel”。兩者在這裡都表示讓問題變得更嚴重。題目已經提供 “rather”，所以答案要接出 “than alleviate”。
“serving a prison term tends to create … the problem of crime”
答案形式檢查： than alleviate = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
放入後： fuel rather than alleviate crime句子文法自然，意思清楚。
學生可能想填 “create rather” 或 “create rather than”，因為原文這幾個字很顯眼。但題目已經用
“fuel” 替代了 create，也已經給了 “rather”。Completion 題要看題目句子缺哪一部分，不能把原文整段照搬。

questions.prompt: “In recognition of the fact that custodial sentences achieve little, less costly and 6_________________ were put forward by the Conservatives in 1990.”
questions.translation: 因為承認 custodial sentences 成效有限，Conservatives 在 1990 年提出了成本較低且 ______。

blocks.text: 這題空格在 “less costly and” 後面，需要一個能和 less costly 並列的形容詞加名詞短語。題目提到 Conservatives in 1990，直接定位到 Paragraph 5 的 Conservative white paper / report。
“More tellingly, reoffending statistics published by the UK Ministry of Justice show a lower rate among offenders who receive a community sentence rather than a custodial one.”
更有說服力的是，UK Ministry of Justice 的再犯統計顯示，接受 community sentence 的offenders，比接受 custodial sentence 的 offenders 再犯率更低。
“Interestingly, the report also argued that there should be a range of community-based sentences which would be cheaper and more effective alternatives to prison.”
有趣的是，該報告也主張應設立一系列 community-based sentences，作為比監獄更便宜、更有效的替代方案。
只看首尾句，可以看到本段從再犯率低轉向 community-based alternatives。Question 6 的
“Conservatives in 1990” 和 “less costly” 正好對應最後一句。
題目中最有定位力的字是：“Conservatives”
“As a Conservative white paper concluded in 1990…”
正如一份 1990 年的 Conservative white paper 所總結……接著最後一句說：
“community-based sentences which would be cheaper and more effective alternatives to prison.”
“cheaper and more effective alternatives to prison”
比監獄更便宜、更有效的替代方案。
題目把 “cheaper” 改寫成 “less costly”，所以空格需要填 “more effective alternatives”。題目句子如下： less costly and more effective alternatives were put forward…這樣 “less costly” 和 “more effective” 同時修飾 alternatives，句子完整。
“were put forward by the Conservatives in 1990”
“the report also argued that there should be…”
答案形式檢查： more effective alternatives = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
只填 “more effective” 會令句子變成 “less costly and more effective were put forward”，名詞不夠完整。原文中的 “alternatives” 很重要，因為題目空格後沒有名詞，所以答案要包括 alternatives。

questions.prompt: “Crime is not only down to individual behaviour but is also a result of 7 _________________influences.”
questions.translation: 犯罪不只源於個人行為，也受到 ______ 影響。

blocks.text: 空格後面已有 “influences”，所以答案需要形容詞短語。題目中的 “individual behaviour” 對應Paragraph 6 中 prisoner being completely responsible for actions；“other influences” 對應 social and economic factors。
“Quite apart from the cost and relative ineffectiveness of incarceration is the short-sightedness of imposing a custodial sentence in the first place.”
除了 incarceration 的成本和相對無效之外，一開始 impose custodial sentence 這件事本身也十分短視。
“Such an oversight only serves to perpetuate crime and punish offenders who need help rather than a penal sentence.”
這種忽視只會延續犯罪，並懲罰那些需要幫助、多於需要刑罰的 offenders。
只看首尾句，可以判斷這段批評 custodial sentence 的思想基礎：若只把 crime 歸咎於個人，便會忽視其他促成犯罪的因素。
“Such an approach overlooks social and economic factors that can play an integral role in the incidence of crime.”
這種做法忽略了 social and economic factors，而這些因素可能在犯罪發生中扮演重要角色。
題目把 “factors” 改寫成 “influences”，所以空格只需要填前面的形容詞部分 “social and economic”。放入後： a result of social and economic influences意思是：犯罪也是社會和經濟影響的結果。
“the prisoner is considered answerable for their behaviour”
“factors that can play an integral role”
答案形式檢查： social and economic = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
不能填 “social and economic factors”，因為題目後面已經有 “influences”。如果填 factors，句子會變成 “factors influences”，文法不通。這題的核心不是只找到原文字，還要讓答案和題目句子接合自然。

questions.prompt: “Mothers who receive a custodial sentence are worse role models for their children than fathers who receive similar sentences.”
questions.translation: 被判 custodial sentence 的母親，比被判類似刑罰的父親更不是好榜樣。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN 題。題目有兩個核心：第一，mothers 和 fathers 的比較；第二，role models，即父母作為榜樣的好壞。原文確實比較 imprisoned mothers 和 imprisoned fathers的子女犯罪風險，但是否有討論 role model quality，要細讀確認。
“Overlooking the social circumstances of the offender can also be detrimental to children’s welfare, especially if a mother is convicted and given a custodial sentence.”
忽略 offender 的 social circumstances 也可能損害兒童福利，尤其當一位母親被定罪並被判custodial sentence 時。
“Viewing the offender and their crime in isolation and disregarding all other social and environmental factors is therefore mistaken, if not downright morally reprehensible.”
因此，把 offender 和其 crime 孤立看待，並無視其他 social and environmental factors，是錯誤的；甚至可說在道德上應受嚴厲批評。
只看首尾句，可以先估 Paragraph 8 講母親入獄如何影響 children’s welfare，以及為何不能忽略家庭和社會環境。這段與題目中的 mothers and children 有關，但未必談 role models。
掃描 Paragraph 8，可以找到 mothers、children、fathers：
“Worse still, figures show that adult children of imprisoned mothers are more likely to be convicted of a crime than adult children of imprisoned fathers.”
更糟的是，數字顯示，被監禁母親的成年子女，比被監禁父親的成年子女更有可能被定罪。
但原文沒有出現 role models，也沒有討論母親或父親作為榜樣的質素。
“adult children of imprisoned mothers are more likely to be convicted of a crime than adult children of imprisoned fathers.”
被監禁母親的成年子女，比被監禁父親的成年子女更有可能被定罪。
這句提供的是結果比較：成年子女日後被定罪的可能性。它沒有解釋原因，也沒有說母親作為榜樣比父親更差。role model 涉及父母對孩子行為、價值觀或模仿對象的影響，這層解釋在原文中沒有出現。

題目命題拆解：主體：mothers who receive custodial sentence比較對象：fathers who receive similar sentences判斷內容：mothers are worse role models比較方向：mothers worse than fathers原文命題：主體：adult children of imprisoned mothers比較對象：adult children of imprisoned fathers判斷內容：more likely to be convicted of a crime沒有提供：role model quality比較結果：文章提供與題目相關的統計背景，但缺少 “worse role models” 這個核心判斷。沒有明確衝突，也沒有足夠支援，所以答案是 NOT GIVEN。
最容易誤選 TRUE 的地方是原文確實說 imprisoned mothers 的 adult children 更可能被定罪。
可是「子女更可能犯罪」不等於「母親作為榜樣更差」。這是一個原因解釋，文章沒有講出來。
IELTS 判斷時，要分清結果統計和原因評價。

questions.prompt: “Custodial sentences are intended primarily to reform prisoners.”
questions.translation: Custodial sentences 的主要目的，是 reform prisoners。

blocks.text: 這題要判斷 custodial sentences 的基本目的。題目中的 “primarily” 是控制詞，表示主要目的。原文一方面提到 incarceration as a method of reforming offenders，但後文更清楚指出 custodial system 的思想基礎是 punitive，即懲罰。
“Quite apart from the cost and relative ineffectiveness of incarceration is the short-sightedness of imposing a custodial sentence in the first place.”
除了 incarceration 的成本和相對無效之外，一開始 impose custodial sentence 這件事本身也十分短視。
“Such an oversight only serves to perpetuate crime and punish offenders who need help rather than a penal sentence.”
這種忽視只會延續犯罪，並懲罰那些需要幫助、多於需要刑罰的 offenders。
只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph 6 在批評 custodial sentence 的根本假設。最後一句說offenders need help more than penal sentence，說明作者認為現行做法太偏向 punishment。
原文中最重要的句子是：
“A punitive system of incarceration presupposes that the prisoner needs to be punished for bad behaviour.”
一套 punitive incarceration system 預設 prisoner 需要因 bad behaviour 受到懲罰。
“A punitive system of incarceration presupposes that the prisoner needs to be punished for bad behaviour.”
一套懲罰性的監禁制度預設 prisoner 需要因不良行為受到懲罰。
這句的核心詞是 “punitive”。Punitive 指以懲罰為導向。後面 “needs to be punished” 進一步把目的說明為 punishment。題目說主要目的在 reform prisoners，但 Paragraph 6 對 custodial system的描述集中在 punishment and responsibility。
“Since the prisoner is considered answerable for their behaviour, it is believed that they are also completely responsible for their actions.”
由於 prisoner 被視為要為自己的行為負責，因此人們相信他們也要為自己的行動完全負責。
這組句子顯示，custodial sentence 的邏輯基礎是個人責任和懲罰。
“needs to be punished for bad behaviour”
比較結果：題目說主要目的在 reform；原文指出制度以 punishment 作出發點。這是方向衝突，所以答案是FALSE。
Paragraph 4 的確出現 “incarceration as a method of reforming offenders”。但那一句的語境是
“many are now beginning to question the validity”，也就是很多人開始質疑這種說法。不能只抓“reforming offenders” 這幾個字。真正控制 Q9 的是 Paragraph 6 對 punitive system 的分析。

questions.prompt: “Factors other than an individual’s guilt are rarely taken into account by the English judicial system.”
questions.translation: 除了個人罪責之外，其他因素很少被 English judicial system 考慮。

blocks.text: 這題問 English judicial / penal approach 是否忽略個人以外的因素。題目中的 “individual’s guilt”對應原文的 “completely responsible for their actions”；“factors other than” 對應 social, economic, environmental factors。
“Quite apart from the cost and relative ineffectiveness of incarceration is the short-sightedness of imposing a custodial sentence in the first place.”
除了 incarceration 的成本和相對無效之外，一開始 impose custodial sentence 這件事本身也十分短視。
“Such an oversight only serves to perpetuate crime and punish offenders who need help rather than a penal sentence.”
這種忽視只會延續犯罪，並懲罰那些需要幫助、多於需要刑罰的 offenders。
只看首尾句，可以先估這段主要講 punitive approach 的盲點。Question 10 的 “factors other than individual guilt” 正是這個盲點。
“Such an approach overlooks social and economic factors that can play an integral role in the incidence of crime.”
這種做法忽略 social and economic factors，而這些因素可能在犯罪發生中扮演重要角色。
“Viewing the offender and their crime in isolation and disregarding all other social and environmental factors is therefore mistaken…”
把 offender 和其 crime 孤立看待，並無視其他 social and environmental factors，是錯誤的。
“Such an approach overlooks social and economic factors that can play an integral role in the incidence of crime.”
這種做法忽略社會和經濟因素，而這些因素可能在犯罪發生中扮演重要角色。
“overlooks” 對應題目 “rarely taken into account”。意思是這些因素未被充分考慮。題目中的“individual’s guilt” 則來自前文：“it is believed that they are also completely responsible for their actions.”
人們相信他們也要為自己的行動完全負責。
所以文章先描述現行 punitive approach 把責任放在個人身上，再批評它忽略 social and economic factors。
答案判斷：題目與原文方向一致。文章明確批評現行 approach 忽略個人以外的因素，所以答案是 TRUE。
“English judicial system” 在原文較常寫成 “English penal system” 或 “punitive system of incarceration”。題目使用 broader wording，但整篇文章討論的是英國監禁和刑罰制度。這個概括沒有越過文章範圍，因為結論段明確說 “English penal system” 需要 shake-up。

questions.prompt: “A proven link exists between mothers receiving a custodial sentence and their offspring committing crimes in later life.”
questions.translation: 母親被判 custodial sentence 和其子女日後犯罪之間，存在已被數字顯示的關聯。

blocks.text: 這題要判斷文章是否提供 mothers’ imprisonment 和 adult children’s crime 之間的 link。需要留意，這裡的 link 應理解為統計關聯，不宜擴大成文章明確證明了直接因果。
“Overlooking the social circumstances of the offender can also be detrimental to children’s welfare, especially if a mother is convicted and given a custodial sentence.”
忽略 offender 的 social circumstances 也可能損害兒童福利，尤其當一位母親被定罪並被判custodial sentence 時。
“Viewing the offender and their crime in isolation and disregarding all other social and environmental factors is therefore mistaken, if not downright morally reprehensible.”
因此，把 offender 和其 crime 孤立看待，並無視其他 social and environmental factors，是錯誤的；甚至可說在道德上應受嚴厲批評。
只看首尾句，可以知道這段會講母親入獄對兒童福利的影響，並用此說明不能把 offender isolated 起來看。Question 11 正好在這個範圍內。
原文中最直接的句子是：
“Worse still, figures show that adult children of imprisoned mothers are more likely to be convicted of a crime than adult children of imprisoned fathers.”
更糟的是，數字顯示，被監禁母親的成年子女，比被監禁父親的成年子女更有可能被定罪。
“figures show that adult children of imprisoned mothers are more likely to be convicted of a crime…”
數字顯示，被監禁母親的成年子女更有可能被定罪。
這句包含三個重要元素：
= 被監禁母親的成年子女，對應題目 offspring in later life。
“more likely to be convicted of a crime”
= 更有可能被定罪，對應 committing crimes in later life。
題目說 “a proven link exists”。原文的 “figures show” 足以支援一種統計關聯。這裡不應把 “link”解讀成文章已證明母親入獄直接造成子女犯罪；文章只明確提供「兩者有關聯」和「比例較高」。
“a mother is convicted and given a custodial sentence”
“adult children … more likely to be convicted of a crime”
答案判斷：文章提供統計句支援題目，所以答案是 TRUE。
這題容易過度解讀。TRUE 的原因是文章支援 “link exists”。若題目改成 “mothers’ imprisonment directly causes their children to commit crimes”，答案便會缺少因果證據。現在題目只說 link，所以可以成立。

questions.prompt: “The English judicial system stands to benefit from incarcerating offenders.”
questions.translation: English judicial system 會從監禁 offenders 中得益。

blocks.text: 這題問 incarceration 是否帶來 identifiable benefit。目標位置在結論段，因為作者總結整個English penal system 的得失。題目中的 “stands to benefit” 要找原文是否提到 winners、benefits或 gains。
“All evidence would seem to point to a much-needed shake-up of the English penal system.”
所有證據似乎都指向一點：English penal system 急需大幅改革。

“Maybe we would do better to go one step further and amend his quotation to ‘The degree of civilisation in a society is revealed by not having prisons and instead by addressing social issues in society itself.’”
也許我們更應該再走前一步，把他的名言改成：一個社會的文明程度，體現在不設監獄，並在社會本身處理社會問題。
只看首尾句，可以看到結論段對 English penal system 的評價非常負面，作者主張改革並把焦點轉向 social issues。這與題目說 judicial system benefits from incarceration 方向相反。
Paragraph 9 中最直接的對應是：
“As things stand, there are too many losers and no identifiable winners.”
按現況來看，輸家太多，且沒有可辨認的贏家。
“As things stand, there are too many losers and no identifiable winners.”
以目前情況而言，輸家太多，而且看不到任何明確的贏家。
如果 English judicial system truly stood to benefit, 原文應該至少承認有一方受益。可是作者說
“no identifiable winners”。這直接推翻題目說法。整篇文章也列出 taxpayer cost、reoffending、children’s welfare 等損害，結論進一步說沒有 winners。
答案判斷：原文提供相反證據：現行制度下沒有可辨認的得益者，所以答案是 FALSE。
題目用 “judicial system” 而原文用 “penal system”。兩者在這篇文章中都指向英國處理 offenders的刑罰制度。真正要判斷的不是用詞差異，而是 benefit 是否存在。結論段的 “no identifiable winners” 已經清楚定案。

questions.prompt: “There are signs that custodial sentences are becoming less popular in the UK.”
questions.translation: 有跡象顯示 custodial sentences 在 UK 正變得較不常用或較不受制度偏好。

blocks.text: 這題要判斷 UK 對 custodial sentences 的趨勢。題目中的 “becoming less popular” 需要和原文中的 prison population、trend towards imposing prison sentences、hardline approach 比較。雖然文章後面說很多人開始質疑 incarceration，實際制度趨勢仍要回到開頭。
“In the Netherlands and parts of the USA such as Johnson County, a move towards rehabilitating offenders has helped to reduce both crime and incarceration rates.”
在 Netherlands 和 USA 部分地區，例如 Johnson County，轉向 rehabilitating offenders 已經有助於同時降低犯罪率和監禁率。
“Without a shadow of a doubt, out of all European countries, the UK has adopted the most hardline approach to offenders.”
毫無疑問，在所有歐洲國家之中，UK 對 offenders 採取了最強硬的做法。
只看首尾句，可以看到 Paragraph 1 把 UK 放在 rehabilitation trend 的反面：其他地方轉向rehabilitation，UK 採取最 hardline approach。這已經不支持 “custodial sentences becoming less popular”。
Paragraph 1 中最直接的句子是：
“Bucking this trend, the UK’s prison population has increased by an average of 3.6% per year since 1993.”
與這個趨勢相反，UK 的 prison population 自 1993 年以來平均每年增加 3.6%。
“The trend towards imposing prison sentences on offenders in the UK seems all the harsher…”
UK 對 offenders imposed prison sentences 的趨勢顯得更加嚴厲。
“the UK’s prison population has increased by an average of 3.6% per year since 1993.”
UK 的 prison population 自 1993 年以來平均每年增加 3.6%。
“The trend towards imposing prison sentences on offenders in the UK seems all the harsher…”
UK 對 offenders 判處 prison sentences 的趨勢顯得更加嚴厲。
“the UK has adopted the most hardline approach to offenders.”
UK 對 offenders 採取了最強硬的做法。
這些句子共同指向同一方向：UK 仍然大量使用 imprisonment，而且走向更嚴厲。題目說custodial sentences becoming less popular，與這個趨勢相衝。
比較結果：題目說使用或偏好下降；原文說 prison population 上升、判監趨勢更嚴厲、制度路線最強硬。因此答案是 FALSE。
Paragraph 4 說 “many are now beginning to question the validity of incarceration”。這確實表示批評聲音增加，但它未能推翻制度使用上的明確趨勢。題目說的是 custodial sentences in the UK becoming less popular；從文章開頭的數據和趨勢看，實際情況正好相反。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：只看每段第一句和最後一句後可建立的粗略地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句說 Netherlands 和 USA 部分地區轉向 rehabilitating offenders，成功減少 crime 和incarceration rates；末句說在所有歐洲國家中，UK 對 offenders 採取最 hardline approach。只看首尾句，可以先估這段是全文立場開場：作者把荷蘭和美國部分地區的 rehabilitation trend，和英國持續上升的 prison population 作對比，建立「監禁政策是否有效」這個核心問題。

首句說 UK 對 offenders imposed prison sentences 的趨勢顯得更嚴厲，因為 Dutch Justice Ministry 正積極關閉監獄；末句說 Dutch reform of the prison system 正以 phenomenal pace 加速，2014 年單年已關閉 19 所監獄。只看首尾句，可以判斷這段集中講 Netherlands prison closures，而且重點在速度和規模：荷蘭改革並非零散小變化，而是快速、系統性地縮減監獄。

首句說 Netherlands 的 prison closures 如預期導致 incarcerated offenders 數字下降；末句說crime rates 也隨 prisons closure 按 direct proportion 下降，這挑戰 pro-incarceration lobbyists 的預期。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會處理一個反直覺結果：監獄關閉、電子標籤增加，卻沒有帶來犯罪上升；相反，犯罪率也下降，支援非監禁措施的有效性。

首句說統計數字公開後，很多人開始質疑 incarceration 作為 reforming offenders 方法的 validity；末句說 probation 或 community service order 的成本比 average prison placement 低 12 倍。只看首尾句，可以判斷這段主要處理成本和替代方案：監禁昂貴，而且 fails to deliver；electronic tagging、probation 和 community service 被塑造成更便宜、可能更有效的處理方式。

首句說 UK Ministry of Justice 的 reoffending statistics 顯示，community sentence 的再犯率低於custodial sentence；末句說 1990 年 Conservative report 主張設立一系列 community-based sentences，作為 cheaper and more effective alternatives to prison。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會把焦點由成本轉到效果：監禁可能 create crime problem，community-based alternatives 在再犯率和成本上都更有說服力。

首句說除了 incarceration 的成本和相對無效外，問題還包括一開始 imposed custodial sentence的 short-sightedness；末句說這種 oversight 只會 perpetuate crime，並懲罰其實需要 help 的offenders。只看首尾句，可以判斷這段在批評 punitive system 的思想基礎：它把犯罪視作個人完全負責，卻忽略 social and economic factors 對犯罪發生的作用。

首句說 UK 借鑑 Netherlands 不會有壞處，因為 Netherlands 透過 addressing social problems 減少 crime 和 incarceration；末句說犯事者會得到 rehabilitation programmes 的幫助。只看首尾句，可以估計這段提供正面模型：若要減少犯罪，政策焦點應放在 social services、deterring crime 和rehabilitation 上，而不是單靠 punishment。

首句說忽略 offender 的 social circumstances 也會損害 children’s welfare，尤其當 mother 被判custodial sentence；末句說把 offender 和 crime isolated 起來、無視 social and environmental factors，是 mistaken，甚至 morally reprehensible。只看首尾句，可以判斷這段把監禁問題擴展到家庭和兒童：母親入獄會造成 childcare 混亂，也可能與下一代犯罪風險有關。
首句說所有證據似乎都指向 English penal system 需要大幅 shake-up；末句改寫 Dostoevsky 的名言，主張文明程度可由不設監獄、改為處理社會問題來體現。只看首尾句，可以判斷這是結論段：作者總結監禁制度帶來 too many losers and no identifiable winners，最後把議題提升到文明、社會責任和制度改革層面。
